newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London drift up in scant trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London drift up in scant trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London drifted up slightly on Monday hugging the coattails of a firmer Wall Street, but trading volume was thin, dealers said.
"There were no real features and most of the market was marked up in sympathy with Wall Street, the FTSE and the long bond. There's been very low turnover," another trader said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index ended the day 22.61 points, or 0.18 percent higher at 12,310.45.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng Index closed 83.25 points, or 0.68 percent higher at 12,287.84 in thin volume.
Wall Street stocks extended Friday's gains to move higher at the open. The Dow Industrials Average was up 47.59 points to 6,573.66 by 1545 GMT.
